latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of aliyun-pixverse-generation skill for Alibaba Cloud PixVerse video models.

- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, keyframe-to-video, and multi-image reference-to-video workflows.
- Selects from four PixVerse model variants for non-Wan video generation tasks.
- Provides clear model selection and parameter guidance for resolution, duration, and region.
- Submits and polls asynchronous video generation tasks via DashScope API.
- Saves normalized requests, responses, and evidence to output files for traceability.
